_doc: Rectangles [x, y, w, h, reason] left out of the pixel diff because what they show differs between any two runs, even of the same shell: live values, a random choice, the phase of an animation that never stops. Keys are fnmatch patterns on shot names; every matching line applies. Each one was measured on two runs of one shell (REPORT.md). The rectangles marked `renamed` are the other kind: a name the shell shows that the project changed on purpose (the shell's own name, now `rusty-impulse`, and `org.quickshell`, now `org.rustshell`), each as tight as the words themselves, one pixel around the pixels that differ.
